Subject: Deployment pricing clarification

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement asked me to get a clearer breakdown of costs for a full private deployment (VPC) so we can compare against our existing on-prem spend. Two immediate asks:

1) Can you split the commercial into (a) platform fee (site entitlement) and (b) operator licenses / node licensing? We need hard monthly numbers for both.
2) What are the SRE/retainer support band options (hours, response SLA, incident credits) and how those map to price?
3) Do you have a pilot-to-production credit or amortization option so the first 6 months aren't a hard hit to our budget?

We'd like to surface an internal recommendation by next Wednesday. Attached our procurement checklist — happy to jump on a short call.

Attachments: SENTINEL_PROCUREMENT_CHECKLIST.xlsx (see line items 4–7)

Best,
Ellen

Sentinel Health
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment pricing clarification

Ellen — thanks for the clear asks. High level answers below; Marissa will follow with exact commercial numbers and an amortization counter. Irene, I'll loop you for SOW/service-level details.

Summary (quick):
- Option A (Anchored): Platform fee = entitlement for private control plane + observability; Operator licenses = per-seat operator/license for on-prem nodes. Good for customers wanting predictable monthly cost.
- Option B (Consumption-first): Lower base platform fee, node-anchored license or per-GPU consumption, plus an SRE retainer for higher SLOs. Better if you want cost tied to actual usage spikes.
- Pilot credit: We can offer a pilot uplift credit. Typical structure we propose: 50% platform fee credit for the first 3 months, or amortized platform fee spread over 18–24 months if you want smoother budget impact.

Questions to narrow numbers:
- Expected steady-state GPU/node count (or QPS baseline)
- Required P0/P1 response windows (we offer 1h/4h/24h mixes)
- Any data residency/airgap constraints (affects one-time engineering effort)

I've attached our support-band summary (short) and an example amortization table. Marissa — can you prepare 2 priced routes (Anchored and Consumption) and a short tradeoff note?

[Attachment: support_band_summary.xlsx]

- Soojin
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Thanks Soojin — this is helpful. A few clarifications from procurement:

- For steady-state, we expect roughly 6–8 GPU nodes (NVIDIA A100-ish equivalent) initially with 18 months roadmap to ~20 nodes.
- We prefer amortization over 24 months for budgeting. Can you show both flat and amortized numbers?
- Pilot credit: procurement prefers a larger safety net — asking if you can move to 60% platform fee credit for the pilot period or a one-time implementation credit.
- We also need rollback/exit protections: what happens if we reduce committed nodes mid-term? Any true-up mechanics?

Attached our standard procurement terms (you can see our preferred amortization clause and monthly true-up language). If possible, include a migration credit in the proposal — that'll help accelerate approvals.

Thanks — Ellen

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Deployment pricing clarification

Ellen — appreciate the detail and the timeline. Below is a concrete commercial counter we can use internally and with procurement. Numbers are illustrative but priced to close if you can confirm an 18-month commercial commitment (with 12-month true-up mechanics).

Commercial counter (two routes):

Route 1 — Anchored model (predictable):
- Platform fee (private control plane + observability): $48,000 / month (month-to-month invoice).
- Operator licenses: $1,200 per operator seat / month (covers node management, upgrades, operator console).
- SRE retainer (optional bands): L1: $12k/month (4hr P1, 24/7 coverage for P0), L2: $6k/month (8/5 faster engineering support) — incident credits apply for missed SLOs.
- Pilot concession: 50% platform fee credit for first 3 months; OR one-time migration credit of $75,000 if you sign by 2026-10-20.

Route 2 — Amortized / Consumption-first (smoother cash flow):
- Anchored platform fee amortized over 24 months: Equivalent monthly hit $38,000 / month (requires 18-month committed term; 12-month true-up if nodes exceed committed).
- Node license: $950 per operator seat / month (lower due to consumption alignment).
- Consumption true-up: monthly true-up for actual GPU nodes above committed baseline.
- Pilot concession: 60% platform fee credit for first 2 months + $35k implementation credit (if you pick amortized route).

Rollback / true-up mechanics:
- If committed nodes reduce below committed baseline, we apply a 3‑month smoothing window then true-up at a 75% factor to avoid immediate churn. For increases, monthly true-up at actual usage. Full terms will be in the SOW.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm preferred route (Anchored vs Amortized).
2) If Amortized, confirm committed baseline (we'll use 8 nodes as the starting point for the quote).
3) If you want the migration credit, confirm internal signoff timeline.

Linking the prospect record for signatures: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

I'll update the SOW with the rollback language and a scoped migration SOW if you want to review.

Best,
Marissa
Sr. Commercial Manager, Redwood Inference
